exhibits.description: Floor plan of the laboratory, showing the LAB, EAST CORRIDOR, EAST EXIT, SERVICE CORRIDOR, and CAFETERIA. The SERVICE CORRIDOR is an unmonitored link to the LAB.
Camera footage from the LAB at 18:00, showing the prototype on a table. The prototype is a rectangular object with a black triangle on top.

Access log showing the entry and exit times of individuals through various doors. Nora Vale entered the EAST_CORRIDOR at 18:10 and exited through the EAST_EXIT at 18:14. Theo Park entered the CAFETERIA at 18:12, and Ada Finch entered the RECEPTION at 18:13.

Witness statements. Nora claims she only visited the east corridor and left. Eli states he did not approach the lab after 18:00. Maya says she carried a cardboard supply box at 18:11. Theo claims he remained in the cafeteria from 18:12. Ada says she staffed reception.

Internal messages. Eli mentions needing the prototype for his project. Maya requests the cardboard consumables box be moved to the loading bay. A security message states that coat descriptions are from shift assignments and that the service corridor is a camera blind spot.

findings.title: Prototype was last seen at 18:00 in the LAB
findings.limitations: Camera footage only confirms the presence of the prototype at 18:00. It does not provide information about the prototype's status after that time.

findings.title: Nora Vale had access to the LAB via the SERVICE CORRIDOR
findings.method: Analysis of floor plan and access log
findings.limitations: The access log only shows Nora Vale's entry and exit through the EAST_CORRIDOR and EAST_EXIT. It does not confirm her entry through the SERVICE CORRIDOR.

findings.title: Nora Vale's statement contradicts the possibility of her entering the LAB
findings.limitations: The witness statement is unverified and could be a lie to cover up her involvement in the theft.
